name: Tartar Sauce
body:
Station and Complexity line cook 2, poissonier 2

Flavor Profiles sour, sweet
Additional Ingredients bitter, salty, sour, or spicy

EFFECT

Duration 1 day/level, or 1 round when consumed; Serving Size 1d6
Saving Throw Will negates

DESCRIPTION

This tangy sauce, usually served with fish, is a mix of mayonnaise, pickles, lemon juice, and sometimes dill.

When added to another meal as an additional sour ingredient, it counts as 2 additional ingredients.

When consumed by itself, it causes a non-magical lesser confusion effect for 2 rounds.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each and allow the tartar sauce to be used as that type of additional ingredient as well.

S-Class Characters: The Culinarian © 2023, Samurai Sheepdog; Author: Kevin Glusing.
